The Inspectors of Education, Children’s Services and Skills (No. 3) Order 2026
summary: This Order appoints the persons named in the Schedule as His Majesty’s Inspectors of Education, Children’s Services and Skills.

title: The Housing (Empty Dwelling Management Orders) (Prescribed Period of Time and Prescribed Requirements) (England) (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: Chapter 2 of Part 4 of the Housing Act 2004 (c. 34) (“the Act”) deals with the making of interim and final empty dwelling management orders (“EDMOs) which may be made by local housing authorities in respect of dwellings which are wholly unoccupied.

title: The Anti-social Behaviour (Provision of Information) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made under section 105A of the Anti-Social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014 (c. 12) (“the 2014 Act”), which enables the Secretary of State to make regulations placing a duty on specified authorities to provide the Secretary of State with specific information relating to anti-social behaviour. This may include information about reports of anti-social behaviour made to the authority, and their response to anti-social behaviour. Under section 105A(3), a relevant authority can be required to collect or obtain, create or produce, retain or process information in order to comply with this duty. A specified relevant authority for the purposes of these Regulations is a local authority (as defined in section 20 of the 2014 Act).

title: The Northern Ireland Assembly (Minimum Period) (Amendment) Order 2026
summary:
By virtue of 
section 31
(1) of the 
Northern Ireland Act 1998 (c. 47), ordinary general elections to the Northern Ireland Assembly are held on the first Thursday in May every five years. The predecessor Assembly must be dissolved at the start of the minimum period which ends with the date of the poll for the election and that period is determined in accordance with an Order made by the Secretary of State.

title: The Income-related Benefits (Subsidy to Authorities) Amendment Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Income-related Benefits (Subsidy to Authorities) Order 1998 (S.I. 1998/562) (“the 1998 Order”) which provides for the calculation and payment of housing benefit subsidy to local authorities in England, Wales and Scotland which administer housing benefit. Sections 140C(4) and 140F(2) of the Social Security Administration Act 1992 (c. 5) authorise the making, revocation or varying of an Order before, during or after the year to which it relates.

title: The Licensing Act 2003 (Applications of Potential Strategic Importance to Greater London etc and Consequential Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: Section 51 of, and Schedule 26 to, the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (c. 23) amended the Licensing Act 2003 (c. 17) by inserting powers enabling the Mayor of London to call in and determine certain licensing applications of potential strategic importance to Greater London. These Regulations supplement those provisions.

title: The Employment Appeal Tribunal (Amendment) (No. 2) Rules 2026
summary: These Rules amend the Employment Appeal Tribunal Rules 1993 (S.I. 1993/2854) (“the 1993 Rules”) which are the rules governing the procedure in the Employment Appeal Tribunal.

title: The Local Authorities (Functions and Responsibilities) (England) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Local Authorities (Functions and Responsibilities) (England) Regulations 2000 (“the 2000 Regulations”). They apply in relation to local authorities in England.

title: The Enterprise Act 2002 (Specification of Additional Section 58 Consideration) Order 2026
summary: Section 58 of the Enterprise Act 2002 (“the Act”) specifies the public interest considerations in relation to which the Secretary of State may intervene in relevant merger situations (as defined in section 23 of the Act) and special merger situations (as defined in section 59 of the Act).

The Social Security (Income and Capital Disregards) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulations 2 to 6 amend respectively the State Pension Credit Regulations 2002 (S.I. 2002/1792), the Housing Benefit Regulations 2006 (S.I. 2006/213), the Housing Benefit (Persons who have attained the qualifying age for state pension credit) Regulations 2006 (S.I. 2006/214), the Employment and Support Allowance Regulations 2008 (S.I. 2008/794), and the Universal Credit Regulations 2013 (S.I. 2013/376).

title: The Global Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Sanctions Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made under the Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2018 (c. 13) to establish a sanctions regime for the purposes of: deterring, and providing accountability for: activities which, if carried out by or on behalf of a State, would amount to serious violations of certain human rights by that State; serious violations of international humanitarian law; and obstruction of the delivery or distribution of, or access to humanitarian assistance around the world.

title: The Five Estuaries Offshore Wind Farm (Correction) Order 2026
summary: This Order corrects errors in the Five Estuaries Offshore Wind Farm Order 2025 (S.I. 2025/1376), a development consent order made under the Planning Act 2008, following a request made under paragraph 1(5)(a) of Schedule 4 to that Act.

title: The Social Security (Further Methods of Recovery) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision in relation to the recovery of debt under Schedules 3ZA and 3ZB to the Social Security Administration Act 1992 (c. 5) (“the Act”), as inserted by the Public Authorities (Fraud, Error and Recovery) Act 2025 (c. 28) (“2025 Act”).

title: The Armed Forces (Service Complaints) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Armed Forces (Service Complaints) Regulations 2015 (S.I. 2015/1955) (“the 2015 Regulations”).

title: The Armed Forces Commissioner Act 2025 (Commencement No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These are the second commencement Regulations made under the Armed Forces Commissioner Act 2025 (c. 23) (“the 2025 Act”).

title: The Armed Forces (Service Complaints Miscellaneous Provisions) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Armed Forces (Service Complaints Miscellaneous Provisions) Regulations 2015 (S.I. 2015/2064) (“the 2015 Regulations”).

title: The Employment Rights Act 2025 (Commencement No. 6 and Transitional and Saving Provisions) Regulations 2026
summary:
These Regulations bring into force certain provisions of the 
Employment Rights Act 2025 (c. 36) (“the 2025 Act”) on 30th October 2026. They are the sixth commencement regulations made under 
the 2025 Act. Certain provisions came into force on Royal Assent by virtue of 
section 159
(1) of 
the 2025 Act and two months after Royal Assent by virtue of 
section 159
(2) of 
the 2025 Act.
